nodes.name: Schedule 09:00 and 21:00 JST
nodes.notes: 1h after WF01 (08:00/20:00 JST) so fresh candidates are verified the same morning/evening. Workflow timezone = Asia/Tokyo.

nodes.name: Config
nodes.notes: Thresholds, wage floors, overseas gate, gBizINFO base URL, AI model, Notion ids.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ filter: { and: [ { property: 'Ingestion Source', select: { equals: 'N8N' } }, { or: [ { property: 'Status', select: { equals: 'EXTRACTED' } }, { and: [ { property: 'Status', select: { equals: 'VERIFICATION_REQUIRED' } }, { property: 'Recheck Required', checkbox: { equals: true } } ] } ] } ] }, sorts: [ { timestamp: 'created_time', direction: 'ascending' } ], page_size: $('Config').first().json.max_per_run }) }}

nodes.name: Query Queue
nodes.notes: Auth: Header Auth credential (Authorization: Bearer <Notion integration secret>) so our Notion-Version 2025-09-03 header is not overridden by the built-in Notion credential.

nodes.name: Flatten Queue
nodes.notes: Queue = N8N-ingested jobs with Status EXTRACTED, or VERIFICATION_REQUIRED + Recheck Required (human re-queue).

nodes.name: Build Registry Request
nodes.notes: Company verification is independent of the posting: by 法人番号 if known, else by company name.

nodes.name: Registry Lookup
nodes.notes: gBizINFO REST API. Credential: Header Auth, name X-hojinInfo-api-token, value = your token.

nodes.name: Company Score
nodes.notes: 法人番号 35 + name 25 + address 20 + active 10 + direct employer 10. >= company_threshold and no conflict => VERIFIED.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify((() => { const r = $json.ai_verify_req; const conv = (c) => Array.isArray(c) ? c.map((b) => b.type === "image" ? { type: "image_url", image_url: { url: b.source && b.source.url } } : b) : c; const body = { model: r.model, max_tokens: r.max_tokens, messages: [{ role: "system", content: r.system }].concat(r.messages.map((m) => ({ role: m.role, content: conv(m.content) }))) }; if (r.temperature !== undefined) body.temperature = r.temperature; return body; })()) }}
